user.title: Telia Play
user.description: Norway uses TV points (Valgmeny) to pick streaming services. Prefer the TV code if you sign in with BankID or Google on teliaplay.no.

data.include_channels: Also create switches for channel packages

password.title: Telia Play password
password.description: Use the mobile number on the Telia TV subscription (not Gmail). The password is the one you set in Telia Play, not your Google password.
